settings.heading: Help shape our work
settings.intro: We're looking for help in three specific ways. It's remote, unpaid, and whenever you have time.

settings.title: Review draft videos
settings.what: Watch videos before release and tell us what works and what doesn't.

settings.title: Pitch video ideas
settings.what: Send us topics, stories, or working solutions we should cover next.

settings.title: Design ideas and feedback
settings.what: Weigh in on our thumbnails, visuals, and merch, or suggest new ones.

settings.heading: Sign up
settings.intro: Leave your details and pick how you'd like to help.
settings.roles:
Review draft videos
Pitch video ideas
Design ideas and feedback
settings.consent_text: We'll only use these details to reply to you about volunteering. We never sell or share them.
settings.success_text: Thanks for signing up. We'll email you when we're ready for your help.
